en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Ja’far Bin Bashir, from Hammad, from Hisham who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Would it suffice me if I were to say in place of the Glorification during the Rukū and the Sajdah, ‘There is no god except for Allahazwj and Allahazwj is the Greatest’?’
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja‘far ibn Bashir form Hammad from Hisham who has said the following: “

I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, ‘Is it sufficient for me to say Tahlil, (no one deserves worship except Allah) and Takbir (Allah is great beyond description) in Ruku‘ (bowing down on one’s knees) instead of Tasbih (Allah is free of all defects).
He (the Imam) said, ‘Yes, it is sufficient.’”
